_comment: F1 org careers pages + detected ATS, verified live 2026-07-17 (see src/f1_scan.py for fetchers). ats:'manual' means no public unauthenticated jobs API was found — check careers_url by hand.

teams.name: McLaren Racing
teams.notes: Moved off Recruitee (board now empty) to Attrax; verified 2026-10-25.

teams.name: Scuderia Ferrari
teams.notes: SAP SuccessFactors — session-based portal, no public unauthenticated jobs API found.

teams.name: Red Bull Racing
teams.notes: Oracle Recruiting Cloud; public CE REST endpoint, site CX_2 (verified 2026-10-25, 23 live reqs).

teams.name: Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team
teams.notes: Next.js site; vacancies are in the page __NEXT_DATA__ (verified 2026-10-25, 7 live).

teams.name: Williams Racing
teams.notes: Attrax board, server-rendered vacancy tiles at /jobs?page=N (verified 2026-10-25, 34 live jobs).

teams.name: Audi F1 Team
teams.notes: Formerly Sauber Motorsport AG / Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber. Custom Next.js site, no discoverable JSON API — job data is client-side rendered.

teams.name: Racing Bulls (VCARB)
teams.notes: Redirects into Red Bull's proprietary jobs.redbull.com portal; no clean JSON API found.

teams.name: Liberty Media Corporation
teams.notes: Parent holding company, a separate legal entity from Formula 1 itself. No matching ATS found; listed no open roles at research time. Low priority.

teams.name: FIA
teams.notes: Legacy eRecruiting system with a working RSS feed. Roles skew technical/regulatory-safety and administrative rather than software — low volume, lower priority per profile.
